<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative milestone:</strong> Parliament has officially passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, following its approval in the Rajya Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQU3ZPV0tBQ0k0Q2ZRTFZWZ1JVTjIyOWY4U2VVcEtUMzNURDBlSUdheU1TamkwWWZSQTczRXR2ZUttTUZkdnBJS2JhdFRQTmlIamtZZEpEQ2ROOVJISm9OSXhEYk84TmUyZUJOTHgzci1PaVFSeTlHMWpzQV9rOWEwWHNualRibzRieVJzSXNRY1ZDdVVsSGhGdEVFRjZXeEhoSnFkS2RnbUNpRFFfaFFiWEQwQUVSbGZiZW91ZFpnTjZOLVF0?oc=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political rhetoric:</strong> The Congress party has launched a sharp critique against the Prime Minister and Home Minister, labeling them &quot;Gyanesh Theft Arrangers&quot; amid ongoing uncertainty regarding the current Parliament session.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Historical and electoral discourse:</strong> The BJP has intensified its campaign against the Nehru-Gandhi family by citing historical election spending, while the INDIA alliance expresses confidence in its electoral prospects for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court has intervened to bar coercive action against SASTRA University in an ongoing land dispute involving 31 acres of government property.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral strategy:</strong> As political parties prepare for future cycles, the BJP has emphasized its constant state of election readiness, while opposition leaders have alleged financial inducements regarding the upcoming Delimitation Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxPQUdkTTcxU0xOekNkQjJTLUZlTmZkYnFfWWRYMXdkbzA5aTJvVGRNTWxtS0trcnNDTkh3NlN0Qmg1SGd0Mng1MlpPNm1PVEo2YVpEb3lGUEJHVWpfd2xfY2VTRnFLb1dtcWNmTUpWRVo5cHQ0OHl5V1BjOWFiMVVNbGtMcDhBVFZieDgtWUo3Zm5Cb1BoT1hnZ2FuNWlhZmZza05KckxDX3d1RFJLVl8wa0c3d256am5TZVFnZFBKUUxDNzA2TkE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
